FINANCING OPTIONS
Scion Solutions products and services powered by Toyota Financial Services (TFS) provide a
number of ways to help you get behind the wheel of a new Scion. See below for some of TFS’ Scion
Solutions programs. For additional financing and leasing options, promotions and information,
please visit www.scion.com/promotions.
SCION PURE LEASE* **
Scion Pure Lease can help you get into your new Scion. Well-qualified Scion customers are
eligible for our best lease terms and may also have their security deposits waived. With leasing,
you may enjoy a lower monthly payment than you would if you were financing the purchase of your
Scion. You also have the flexibility of driving a new vehicle every few years without having to worry
about selling your vehicle at the end of the lease term.
RETAIL FINANCE PLAN/SPECIAL APRs*
If you plan to keep your Scion for a while and drive more than 15,000 miles a year, the Scion Solutions
Retail Finance Plan can be a great choice. Well-qualified customers are eligible for competitive
Annual Percentage Rates or special rates on select models making it easy to get the Scion you want.
SCION MILITARY REBATE PROGRAM*
Scion appreciates the men and women of the U.S. military for their service and dedication to our
country. To thank them, Scion is offering a $500 rebate to eligible and qualified active duty and
reserve personnel, recent retirees and veterans honorably discharged within one year of service,
DETAILS/SPECIAL FEATURES household members of qualified military personnel living at the same address, and Gold Star
family members.
